items.t: Dual-clutch transmission jerks or hesitates at low speed
items.job: Transmission software update and clutch adaptation (fluid service or clutch pack if worn)
items.note: Software updates are usually free under warranty or bulletin. A dual-clutch fluid service alone runs about $800–$1,500 at a shop; worn clutches cost more.

items.t: Transmission won't shift into reverse
items.job: Transmission diagnosis and software update (internal repair if needed)
items.note: Usually software; parts are only needed if the dual-clutch unit has an internal fault.

items.t: Transmission slips into neutral after coasting in Eco mode
items.job: Transmission control software update
items.note: Normally done free by the dealer.

items.t: Fuel rail or injectors can leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel rail and fuel injectors under recall

items.t: Front axle carrier can corrode and fail (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front axle carrier under recall

items.t: Coolant leak and low-coolant warning
items.job: Replace leaking coolant line and refill coolant

items.t: Fuel smell from leaking fuel supply hose
items.job: Replace fuel supply hose
items.note: May be covered at no cost under Mercedes' extended warranty on this hose.

items.t: Car won't unlock or start with 'Battery - Start Engine' message
items.job: Battery test, software update and battery replacement if needed

items.t: Carbon buildup on intake valves
items.job: Intake valve walnut-blast cleaning

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil seepage
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket

items.t: Driver door lock switch can corrode, risking rollaway (recall)
items.job: Replace driver door lock under recall

items.t: Driver airbag may not be properly bolted (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver airbag module under recall

items.t: Brake pedal plate can bend (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace brake pedal under recall

items.t: Water in the footwells from A/C drain hose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and correct A/C condensation drain hose under recall

items.t: Rearview camera image doesn't show (recall)
items.job: Camera and multimedia software update under recall

items.t: Emergency call (eCall) may not work (recall)
items.job: Communication module software update under recall

items.t: LED headlights misaimed after repair (recall)
items.job: Replace LED headlights under recall

items.t: Headlights aimed incorrectly (recall)
items.job: Inspect and adjust headlights under recall

items.t: Missing rear brake pad wear gauge (recall)
items.job: Supply rear brake pad inspection gauge under recall

items.t: Rear child seat anchor may be missing a bar (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear ISOFIX bracket under recall

items.t: Creaking or grinding from steering column
items.job: Lubricate or replace steering column parts per bulletin

items.t: Steering vibration when parking or at low speed
items.job: Power steering software update and tire check

items.t: Front brakes squeal when stopping
items.job: Service or replace front brake pads per bulletin

items.t: Chirping or tapping from engine pulley when cold
items.job: Diagnose and repair crankshaft pulley noise per bulletin

items.t: Humming or vibration from rear axle when maneuvering
items.job: Rear drive unit software update or repair

items.t: Squeak or rattle from exhaust flap
items.job: Replace exhaust flap valve or actuator
items.note: May be covered under Mercedes' extended warranty on the exhaust valve system.

items.t: Check engine light from fuel pump control software
items.job: Fuel pump control module software update
items.note: Covered by Mercedes' emissions warranty extension.

items.t: Side windows squeak or stick when moving
items.job: Replace or adjust inner window sealing rail

items.t: MBUX screen freezes, goes dark or reboots
items.job: Head unit software update
items.note: Usually free; a replacement head unit would cost much more.

items.t: Water leak from panoramic sunroof drains
items.job: Clear sunroof drain tubes

items.t: Front control arm bushings and ball joints wear
items.job: Replace front lower control arm (one side)
